title: carlina baetica
intro: Carlina baetica, commonly known as Baetic thistle, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Carlina baetica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing muscle cramps and relieving anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Carlina baetica include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
